_comment: Skills each Role run is handed by dispatch (lib/skills.mjs). Rules: only model-loadable skills, at most maxSkills per run, stack rules only when the repo uses that stack. User-only skills (wayfinder, how, why, blast-radius, interrogate, to-spec, to-tickets) are never called from a role; role prompts tell the human when to run them. Stack-specific rule skills (Flutter, Supabase, React Native, ...) are deliberately not part of this setup; add a stacks entry to bring one back.
